subject: [CloudGrid x Redwood] Marketplace co-sell demo: integration + runbook sync
messages:
From: Jesse Huang <jesse@cloudgrid.io>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudGrid x Redwood marketplace co-sell demo — integration scope and windows

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the intro — excited to get this scheduled. We're pairing our CloudGrid SI team with the AWS Marketplace listing folks for a joint technical + procurement demo. High level ask from our side:

- 40m technical walk-through (integration points + latency/cost assumptions)
- 20m procurement/marketplace ops (listing timeline, billing flow, recording ownership)

Constraints: our SI lead (Maya) is only available 6/22–6/24 in the morning PT due to an onsite with a customer. AWS partner team prefers afternoons PT. Can we find a compromise window?

I've attached a draft agenda and a short runbook sketch — please confirm who from Redwood will own the recording and the runbook updates.

Attachments: CloudGrid_SI_Agenda.pdf, runbook-draft.md

Thanks,
Jesse Huang
CloudGrid, Strategic Integrations
ops@cloudgrid.io
From: avery_johnson@redwood.com <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Jesse Huang <jesse@cloudgrid.io>, aws-partner-eng@amazon.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudGrid x Redwood marketplace co-sell demo — integration scope and windows

Thanks Jesse — good to meet you.

Quick responses:
- Redwood will own the recording and the post-demo runbook consolidation (we'll publish the final copy to the partner folder).
- For the agenda you shared, can we move to a 60/30 split? 60m tech (we have a couple deeper perf slides) + 30m marketplace ops.

Proposed compromise windows (PT):
- Tue 6/23 10:00–11:30 PT (Maya morning / AWS midday)
- Wed 6/24 13:00–14:30 PT (Maya afternoon / AWS late afternoon)

Kimberly — can you confirm whether the 6/23 morning slot works for our documentation and ops leads? Vivek — need you for the perf section if possible.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Sr. Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com
Cc: Jesse Huang <jesse@cloudgrid.io>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, aws-partner-eng@amazon.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 13:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudGrid x Redwood marketplace co-sell demo — integration scope and windows

Avery / Jesse — thanks. 6/23 10:00–11:30 PT should work for Redwood ops. Two asks from my side:

1) Can we confirm the runbook owner & post-demo action items before the call? I'd like a short spreadsheet of owners so procurement can hit people quickly after the call.
2) Any PBX/recording restrictions from AWS side? We need to be sure recording is allowed for the marketplace listing.

I've attached a checklist I use for marketplace demos (small doc) — will share the owners column once Vivek confirms availability.

Attachment: MOA_signpage.pdf

Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Maya Singh <m.singh@cloudgrid.io>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: aws-partner-eng@amazon.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudGrid x Redwood marketplace co-sell demo — integration scope and windows

Hey all — Maya from CloudGrid SI here (Jesse looped me in). 6/23 10:00 PT is good for me. A couple quick notes from the SI side:

- We'll demo the CloudGrid connector and a sample end-to-end provisioning flow (10–12 mins).
- For performance numbers, we can bring a pre-recorded microbenchmark as backup in case the live demo hits rate limits.
- We require a contact for post-demo action items (ticket owner) — can Redwood own a single incident ticket that we can reference?

Avery — can we add a 10m buffer at the end for Q&A and next steps?

Thanks,
Maya Singh
CloudGrid Senior SI Engineer
From: avery_johnson@redwood.com <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <m.singh@cloudgrid.io>, Jesse Huang <jesse@cloudgrid.io>, aws-partner-eng@amazon.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudGrid x Redwood marketplace co-sell demo — integration scope and windows

All — locking 6/23 10:00–11:40 PT (60m tech + 30m ops + 10m buffer). Calendar invites sent to listed participants.

Action items assigned:
- Recording & upload: Redwood Ops (kimberly_park@redwood.com) — will publish to partner folder and drop link in HubSpot.
- Post-demo incident ticket: redwood-support+cloudgrid@redwood.com (Vivek will own triage).
- Runbook consolidation: Avery + Maya to co-edit (runbook-draft.md) — final version due 6/28.

Kimberly — re: AWS recording restrictions, if AWS flags we will fall back to local recording + CloudGrid share and note in runbook.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://redwood.app/hubspot/deal/DEAL-78932 — please attach final runbook.

See you all on Tuesday.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Sr. Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
